find: if (inspected.frameCount === 0) throw new Error('GIF has no image frames');
replace: if (inspected.frameCount < 0) throw new Error('GIF has no image frames');
killedBy: showcase gifFacts (issue #1062) throws on a well-formed GIF with no frames rather than reporting zeros
why: The block parser accepts a well-formed GIF with no image blocks and reports 0 frames in 0 cs, which passes the frame-rate, duration and loop rules. Measuring it would publish an empty clip; gifFacts must refuse it as it refuses a truncated file.
